title: a release that stops after the bump locks the session out of the script that resumes it
detail: After release.sh exited mid-way (0.270.0, bogus publish FAILED), the pin (0.270.0) was ahead of the installed engine (0.269.0), so every hook refused every Bash call, including scripts/release.sh, which the refusal itself names as the fix. The operator had to type '! scripts/release.sh'. While the pin is ahead of the installed engine in the engine repo, the pre-tool hook should allow exactly scripts/release.sh.
